summary: Add a service-provider document upload section with administrator-only review and verification workflow.

existing_features.title: Replace the placeholder “Verification Review” admin page with a functional Administrator verification review UI that allows the Administrator to browse providers, open a provider’s profile for review (identity + service info + uploaded verification documents + current status), and click a “Verify” button to mark the provider as Verified.

Replace the placeholder provider “Verification Status / Document Upload” page with a working document upload & submission UI for providers, including status display (Unverified / Pending / Verified / Rejected) and a submission action that sends the required documents for Administrator review.

Update all user-facing terminology in the verification-related UI to use “Administrator” instead of “technical team”, including admin-only tooling panels that are currently labeled “Technical Team Tools”.
Add React Query hooks and UI wiring needed to call the new backend verification/document endpoints, ensuring relevant queries are invalidated so status changes appear without a full reload.

new_feature_requests.summary: Service providers can upload required documents; Administrator can view and approve/reject them with statuses (Pending/Approved/Rejected), and terminology uses “Administrator” (not “technical team”).
Administrator is solely responsible for reviewing a service provider’s profile and can confirm completion by clicking a “Verify” button.

Implement backend endpoints for a provider verification workflow where service providers can submit required verification documents and the Administrator can review a provider’s full profile and set the provider’s verification status via a single “Verify” action.

projectName: Administrator-only provider verification workflow (documents + Verify button)
